question: MOLK is related to RTQP in a certain way based on the English alphabetical order. In the same way, GIFE is related to LNKJ. To which of the given options is VXUT related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/69a2832bc87cbf471d2bebb73ea5e3f22b2585b29caf9f9406f09cf2772a4d7d.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'MOLK is related to RTQP'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f196c4bc2a79309a20b32410e132fec3cd5ea7176c6a0fde7aa2186b2780859.png] 

For, 'GIFE is related to LNKJ'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/21c6b46fdd27338c7ef4b15c0aa7f20b4be5dc45a65a4caee22f516f570f853f.png] 

Similarly, for **'****VXUT'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95bce39d5ee25e751aeb4a6608e6bf993d57f0d8efb6ead76b1d293224bf78c0.png] 

So, 'VXUT'' will be related to **'ACZY'**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
